headline: Global Coal Supply Struggles to Keep Pace With Demand
summary: Global coal supply is struggling to keep pace with strong ongoing demand.
why: Coal remains a vital baseline fuel for power generation across Asia, and production shortfalls can elevate electricity input costs and drive substitution into natural gas.

impacts.name: Thermal coal
impacts.why: Persistent supply constraints relative to demand support upward pressure on international coal prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
